biotools.summary:
Gene expression analysis web application. Allows raw counts data exploration and differential expression analysis with DESeq2, Limma-Voom. Workflows include GSEA, ORA, correlations and various plots for publication. Supported organisms: Arabidopsis thaliana, Mus musculus, Homo sapiens.


You can choose to upload your counts data to the app server to perform expression analysis and do various explorations, eg transform and normalize your data in various ways, producing PCA, sample correlations and other plots and tables. In such workflow, your data is handled according to the app privacy policy section, eg. never sent to 3d parties and encrypted.


You can provide DE results of your experiment produced elsewhere to the app UI in case you do not want to upload your data to the app server. This way nothing is uploaded to the server, and you can do all the downstream analyses like GSEA completely in your browser locally.
